content.short: Concrete is on-chain yield infrastructure powering automated, risk-managed vault products across ecosystems.
content.description: Concrete builds full-stack yield infrastructure: automated, risk-managed vaults that combine quantitative modelling with modular architecture and cross-chain integrations. It powers institutional-grade vault products rather than a single retail interface, and on Stable it is one of the largest capital allocators on the network. Its pitch is that a vault's risk management should be engineered into the product rather than left to each depositor to evaluate.
